data.title: 罗丝薇瑟 · 晨曦厨房的围裙私密温存
data.description: 清晨阳光照进整洁的厨房，罗丝薇瑟光洁娇躯上仅系着一条粉色围裙。被你从身后按在灶台边深情索吻，她娇躯轻颤、双颊通红，一边喘息一边幸福地紧扣你的双手。
data.action: standing at stove with only a thin apron over bare sun-warmed skin, pinned against counter by partner from behind, gasping with flushed face and loving teary smile
data.lighting: bright morning sunlight washing over bare legs and flushed skin
data.mood: morning newlywed ecstasy, bare apron intimacy, sweet surrendered domestic passion
data.promptProse: Pinned against the morning kitchen counter wearing only an apron, Rossweisse gasps with flushed cheeks, tightly holding partner hands in sweet bliss.
